mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, created_by, export_mode, task_ids_json, country_iso2s_json, request_hash, status, snapshot_at, lease_until, claim_token, attempt_count, storage_key, file_name, content_type, file_size, summary_row_count, detail_row_count, error_message, created_at, updated_at, finished_at, expires_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO marketing_task_export_job (tenant_id, created_by, export_mode, task_ids_json, country_iso2s_json, request_hash, status, snapshot_at, attempt_count, summary_row_count, detail_row_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{createdBy}, #{exportMode}, #{taskIdsJson}, #{countryIso2sJson}, #{requestHash}, #{status}, #{snapshotAt}, #{attemptCount}, #{summaryRowCount}, #{detailRowCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM marketing_task_export_job WHERE attempt_count < 3 AND (status = 'PENDING' OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until < #{now})) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE marketing_task_export_job SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, lease_until = NULL, claim_token = NULL, finished_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until < #{now} AND attempt_count >= 3
mapper.select: SELECT FROM marketing_task_export_job WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND expires_at <= #{now} AND storage_key IS NOT NULL ORDER BY expires_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE marketing_task_export_job SET status = 'PROCESSING', lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, claim_token = #{claimToken}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, error_message = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND attempt_count < 3 AND (status = 'PENDING' OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until < #{now}))

UPDATE marketing_task_export_job SET status = 'SUCCESS', storage_key = #{storageKey}, file_name = #{fileName}, content_type = #{contentType}, file_size = #{fileSize}, summary_row_count = #{summaryRowCount}, detail_row_count = #{detailRowCount}, error_message = NULL, lease_until = NULL, claim_token = NULL, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, updated_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND claim_token = #{claimToken}
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.reason_code, ''))) = 'CHAT_TERMINATED' OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.group_status_reason, ''))) = 'CHAT_TERMINATED' THEN '已解散' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.reason_code, ''))) IN ('GROUP_BANNED', 'BANNED', 'CHAT_SUSPENDED') OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.group_status_reason, ''))) = 'CHAT_SUSPENDED' OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.group_status, ''))) IN ('BANNED', 'GROUP_BANNED') THEN '已封禁' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.reason_code, ''))) IN ('KICKED_OUT', 'ACCOUNT_NOT_PARTICIPANT') OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.group_status_reason, ''))) = 'ACCOUNT_NOT_PARTICIPANT' THEN '账号已被移出' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.reason_code, ''))) IN ('NO_PERMISSION', 'ANNOUNCE_ONLY_NON_ADMIN') OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.group_status_reason, ''))) = 'ANNOUNCE_ONLY_NON_ADMIN' OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.group_status, ''))) = 'NO_PERMISSION' THEN '无发言权限' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.reason_code, ''))) = 'ACCOUNT_BANNED' THEN '账号封禁' WHEN protocol.projected_status = 1 OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.group_status, ''))) = 'NORMAL' OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.group_status_reason, ''))) = 'GROUP_SEND_ALLOWED' THEN '正常' WHEN health.is_banned = 1 THEN '已封禁' WHEN health.health_status = 1 THEN '正常' WHEN health.health_status = 2 THEN '链接失效' WHEN health.health_status = 3 THEN '不可用' ELSE '未确认' END
mapper.select: WITH SELECT joinedTaskAt, taskId, taskName, groupName, groupLink, groupStatus, speechPermission, groupMemberCount, joinedPhoneCount, plannedCount, successCount, failedCount, unknownCount, senderPhone, accountStatus, firstSentAt, lastSentAt, sendStatus, failureReason, remark FROM group_rows ORDER BY taskId ASC, groupKey ASC

WITH SELECT group_data.taskId, group_data.taskName, group_data.groupName, group_data.groupLink, group_data.groupStatus, group_data.groupMemberCount, identity.phone AS memberPhone, CASE WHEN member_role.is_owner = 1 THEN '群主' WHEN member_role.is_admin = 1 THEN '管理员' WHEN member_role.is_admin = 0 THEN '群成员' ELSE '未知' END AS role, NULL AS countryName, CASE WHEN member.membership_status = 1 THEN '是' WHEN member.membership_status IN (3, 4, 5) THEN '否' ELSE '未知' END AS inGroup, CASE WHEN member.membership_status IN (3, 4) AND member.status_source = 'PARTICIPANT_REMOVE' THEN '被移出群' WHEN member.membership_status IN (3, 4) AND member.status_source = 'PARTICIPANT_LEAVE' THEN '主动退群' ELSE '' END AS exitType, CASE WHEN member.membership_status IN (1, 5) AND history.exited_at IS NOT NULL AND (history.joined_at IS NULL OR history.joined_at <= history.exited_at) THEN NULL ELSE history.joined_at END AS joinedAt, CASE WHEN member.membership_status IN (3, 4) AND member.status_source IN ('PARTICIPANT_REMOVE', 'PARTICIPANT_LEAVE') THEN member.occurred_at END AS exitedAt, CASE WHEN successful_join.joined_at BETWEEN COALESCE(group_data.joinedTaskAt, 0) AND #{snapshotAt} THEN '本任务成功进群' ELSE '原群成员' END AS taskJoinStatus FROM group_rows group_data JOIN member_state member ON member.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND member.group_jid = group_data.groupJid LEFT JOIN member_identity identity ON identity.tenant_id = member.tenant_id AND identity.group_jid = member.group_jid AND identity.member_jid = member.member_jid LEFT JOIN member_role member_role ON member_role.tenant_id = member.tenant_id AND member_role.group_jid = member.group_jid AND member_role.member_jid = member.member_jid LEFT JOIN member_history history ON history.tenant_id = member.tenant_id AND history.group_jid = member.group_jid AND history.member_jid = member.member_jid LEFT JOIN successful_join_members successful_join ON successful_join.tenant_id = member.tenant_id AND successful_join.group_jid = member.group_jid AND successful_join.phone = identity.phone WHERE group_data.groupJid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(group_data.groupJid) <> '' ORDER BY group_data.taskId ASC, group_data.groupKey ASC, member.member_jid ASC
